root_idea.summary: A semantic orientation around a hollow made by digging, especially a well, with related extensions to pits, concealment, and things laid up in store.
root_idea.development: The supplied lexical evidence develops from digging a well or cooking-pit to hiding or storing something, doing good in advance as a stored benefit, and specialized formations for a trap-pit, stored provision, and well-digger.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun is a distinct lexical headword and is normalized to the classical citation form بِئْرٌ.

senses.definition: A well; a dug excavation or shaft.
senses.usage_conditions: In the supplied Quranic occurrence, the noun denotes a well in the expression وَبِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sink or dig a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb describing the act of making a well by digging.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dig a hollow or pit in the ground for cooking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; the hollow is specifically described as one used for cooking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hide or conceal something, and to store or lay it up for a time of need.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; the storage may be understood as concealed provision kept for future need.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do good beforehand, especially by laying up good for oneself or doing it secretly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use with خيرًا; explanations connect the advance good with something laid up or concealed for future benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hollow or hole dug in the ground for cooking; also a place in which a fire is lighted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun for a ground hollow or fire place, distinct from the ordinary well noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make, assign, or appoint a well for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV verb used with a person as the beneficiary or recipient of the well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing stored or laid up for a time of need.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun denoting stored provision or something reserved for future need.
A professional or occupational designation; بَأّارٌ is also reported as a variant form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A covered pitfall into which a passer-by falls; figuratively, tale-bearing that brings someone into calamity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun whose literal pitfall is extended figuratively to harmful tale-bearing.
